content.user_title: Draft and Send Personalized Email Campaigns
content.value_statement: Templates, recipient records, approvals, and delivery status can make email work inconsistent. This skill guides reusable templates, confirmed sending, progress tracking, and cancellation through SoftSync.
actual_capabilities: Check whether a connected mailbox is available before email operations.
List and retrieve reusable email templates for review.
Create or update templates using approved record placeholders.
Send a template to one recipient or multiple recipient records.
Track campaign progress and cancel messages that have not been sent.
limitations: It requires a mailbox that the workspace has already connected.
It cannot recall messages after they are sent.
Large campaigns may take time because mailbox hourly and daily limits pace delivery.
It only supports recipient addresses stored on the selected records.

use_cases.title: Prepare a customer outreach email
use_cases.description: Create or refine a reusable message with approved record placeholders, then review the subject and body before saving.

use_cases.title: Send a confirmed contact campaign
use_cases.description: Select a verified template and recipient records, show the recipient count, and send only after the user gives clear approval.

use_cases.title: Monitor and stop a campaign
use_cases.description: Check delivery progress and cancel messages that remain queued when campaign details or recipient eligibility changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable email template for a thank-you message to contacts. Use only available contact placeholders, then show the saved subject and body.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing template
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the template named [template name], replace [specific wording] with [new wording], save the change, and show the updated subject and body.

prompt_templates.title: Send to approved recipients
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the approved template [template name] for verified contacts: [record names]. Show the template and count, then wait for my clear approval.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Check campaign [campaign name]. Cancel remaining unsent messages and report what was canceled and what was already sent.

output_examples.input: Create a thank-you email for contacts after a consultation.
output_examples.output: Saved template: Consultation thank-you. Subject: Thank you for your time, {{first_name}}. Body: A concise thank-you message using the approved contact placeholder.

output_examples.input: Show me the template and recipient count before sending it to the selected contacts.
output: Status: Awaiting your clear approval before sending

output_examples.input: Stop the campaign that is still sending.
output_examples.output: Campaign cancellation requested. Messages already delivered cannot be recalled; remaining unsent messages were canceled.

best_practices: Review the exact template and recipient count before approving a send.
Check available placeholders before writing or changing a template.
Use campaign status checks for large sends because delivery is paced by mailbox limits.
anti_patterns: Do not invent recipient addresses or bypass stored recipient records.
Do not assume a large campaign is delivered when the send call returns.
Do not expect cancellation to recall messages that were already sent.

faq.question: Can this skill send an email to one person?
faq.answer: Yes. It can send a selected template to one recipient record or to multiple recipient records.

faq.question: Does saving a template send email?
faq.answer: No. Creating or changing a template saves content only and sends nothing.

faq.question: How does the skill choose the email address?
faq.answer: It uses the address stored on each selected recipient record. It does not invent addresses.

faq.question: What approval is required before sending?
faq.answer: The workflow shows the template and recipient count, then waits for a clear user confirmation.

faq.question: Can I cancel a campaign?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can cancel messages that have not gone out yet. Sent messages cannot be recalled.

faq.question: Why can a large campaign take time?
faq.answer: Delivery is paced under the connected mailbox hourly and daily limits, so the send call may return before delivery finishes.
